Author: brady.woods
Name: Sticker Chat
Punchline: Turns auto-translate phrases into stickers over players' heads.
Description:
When someone sends a chat message made up only of auto-translate phrases, replaces their native chat bubble with a sticker image. Mapping is 1:1 and user configurable. Receive-only: this plugin never sends chat.

Proof of concept. Bubble replacement targets the MiniTalkPlayer addon added in patch 7.3 and is not yet verified in-game; use /stickerchat debug to inspect.
